title: Electric Food-Mixers (Liquidizers and Grinders) and Centrifugal Juicers — Specification

parameters.expected: Heat and moisture-resisting finish, not adversely affected by temperature variations in normal operation or during the endurance test; body finish of the food mixer shall not become stained by spillage of foodstuff from the bowl
Relevant provisions of 8 to 32 of IS 302 (Part 2/Sec 14) apply; tests of 11 (heating), 20 (stability), 22 (construction) and 24 (components) carried out per Annex A of this standard

parameters.parameterName: Endurance for motor and base assembly (48 ON-hours)
parameters.expected: Unit (excluding jars) operated at rated input on generator load (Annex B): 24 ON-hours at 1.06 × rated voltage + 24 ON-hours at 0.94 × rated voltage, in ON/OFF cycles per operation class — (a) rated ON < 5 min: 6 ×, 3 min ON / 2 min OFF; (b) rated ON ≥ 5 min: 6 ×, 5 min ON / 2 min OFF; (c) rated ON > 30 min: (rated ON ÷ 5, rounded) ×, 5 min ON / 2 min OFF; (d) continuous: ≥ 10 × or until steady, 5 min ON / 2 min OFF; rest ≤ 60 min to room temperature; total ON time = 48 h; OLP short-circuited; highest speed; coupler breakage due to fixture excluded. After test: withstand electric strength test of 16.3 of IS 302-1
Material retained on 710-micron sieve not more than 20 percent of end-of-test weight
Material retained on 500-micron sieve not more than 20 percent of end-of-test weight
Material passing 355-micron sieve not less than 30 percent of end-of-test weight

Charge = 40 percent of rated capacity of grinder bowl, freshly roasted 'light roast' seeds per IS 3077; operational time ≤ 3 min; total time incl. rest ≤ 5 min; one mid-test scrape permitted at rest (applicable to machines with dry grinding arrangement)

Charge = egg whites (g) equal to 20 percent of liquidizer bowl rated capacity (ml), fresh, at room temperature; whisked to stiff froth; operational time ≤ 3 min, total ≤ 5 min; satisfactory if bowl inverted for 5 s and material remains in bowl (applicable to machines with whisking arrangement)

parameters.parameterName: Idli batter — black gram charge (solids + soak water)

0.5.expected: 100 g decuticled black gram (Urad dal) soaked in 225 ml water for 12 h

1.expected: 200 g decuticled black gram (Urad dal) soaked in 450 ml water for 12 h

1.5.expected: 300 g decuticled black gram (Urad dal) soaked in 675 ml water for 12 h

parameters.parameterName: Idli batter — parboiled rice charge (solids + soak water)

0.5.expected: 100 g parboiled rice soaked in 113 ml water for 12 h

1.expected: 200 g parboiled rice soaked in 225 ml water for 12 h

1.5.expected: 300 g parboiled rice soaked in 338 ml water for 12 h

parameters.expected: Ground ≤ 6 min per ingredient (rest as recommended by manufacturer); mixture worked between thumb and fingers shall be smooth and frothy with no lumps detected; up to 20 percent excess water may be added during grinding

parameters.parameterName: Rice residue on 1.40 mm sieve, Max
parameters.expected: Not more than 10 percent of the mass of rice originally taken retained by the 1.40 mm sieve

parameters.parameterName: Rice residue on 1.00 mm sieve, Max
parameters.expected: Not more than 15 percent of the mass of rice originally taken retained by the 1 mm sieve

parameters.parameterName: Rice residue on 0.5 mm sieve, Max
parameters.expected: Not more than 70 percent of the mass of rice originally taken retained by the 0.5 mm sieve
Amount of juice extracted, as percentage of carrots/fruit taken, not less than 50 percent

parameters.parameterName: Juicer operation — test conditions and flow
parameters.expected: Carrots/fresh seasonal fruits soaked 24 h, topped-tailed, cut ~20 mm thick; batch juicers: ~350 g per cycle × 5 cycles; continuous juicers: 5 min or rated operating time, whichever is less; juice filtered through 0.25 mm sieve and weighed; juice pouring from the vent shall have an even flow
After dismantling, cleaning and inspection: no spillage/leakage from the centrifugal mesh to parts of the juicer that do not form the flow path of the extracted juice

Boiling water poured rapidly into bowl at room temperature to full capacity; emptied and returned to room temperature; repeated 5 times: no sign of cracks or deformation, and bowl properly fits into holder (not applicable to metal bowls)
Controlling switches for overload protection shall break the stalled motor current at maximum rated voltage six times without failure (rated capacity taken equivalent to rated input)

Bowl assembled and mounted on motor housing six times — press-fit joints with 25 kgf force; screwed joints with 25 kgf·cm screwing couple: no chipping, cracking or visible denting on mounting surfaces
Provisions of 20 of IS 302 (Part 2/Sec 14) apply, except tests 20.104, 20.112, 20.113 and 20.114 kept in abeyance for 36 months from publication of this standard

Compact, self-contained, rigid; hygiene-critical parts readily accessible without special tools; castings smooth, round-edged, free from blow holes/pits/foreign matter; parts interchangeable, wear parts easily replaceable; liquidizer lid (held firmly, with breather); lid for open-type grinder bowl; no accidental bodily contact with cutters/blades in normal operation; lubricants shall not contaminate food; food kept from moving parts except blades/cutters; cutters and food-contact parts of non-fouling, corrosion/rust-resistant material (e.g. stainless steel)

Body/motor housing of cast iron, cast aluminium, sheet metal, high-impact thermosetting plastics or thermoplastics (ABS, polypropylene, etc.) of adequate strength; ventilation openings screened against spillage; flexible, easily replaceable power coupling withstanding 48 h use, shock and vibrations; sleeve or ball bearings, permanently lubricated, life ≥ 48 h; bowl of materials neutral to food acids/salts, withstanding up to 100 °C (glass, high-impact thermosetting plastic, or stainless steel), easily removable, free from pits/cracks/crevices, smooth without corners/niches; tool-free stable mounting with accurate guides, gasket + mechanical seal where bowl detaches from base plate; blades of cutters of stainless steel

parameters.testMethod: IS 302 (Part 2/Sec 14):2009, Cl 11 per IS 4250 Annex C / IS 302-1:2024, Cl 11
parameters.expected: Operated on generator load (Annex B setup) at rated power input, most unfavourable voltage between 0.94 and 1.06 × rated; ON/OFF cycles per operation class as in Cl 9; OLP short-circuited; highest speed; winding temperature rise Δt = ((R₂−R₁)/R₁)(k+t₁)−(t₂−t₁), k = 234.5 (copper) / 225 (aluminium), by resistance method (thermocouples if windings non-uniform); temperature rises shall not exceed the values of Table 3 per 11 of IS 302-1

parameters.parameterName: Protection against access to live parts
parameters.expected: Shall comply with 8 of IS 302 (Part 2/Sec 14)
Shall comply with 10 of IS 302 (Part 2/Sec 14)

parameters.parameterName: Leakage current and electric strength at operating temperature
parameters.expected: Shall comply with 13 of IS 302 (Part 2/Sec 14) (also a routine test per Table 3)
Shall comply with 15 of IS 302 (Part 2/Sec 14)
Shall comply with 16 of IS 302 (Part 2/Sec 14)
Shall comply with 27 of IS 302 (Part 2/Sec 14) (also a routine test per Table 3)

Every food-mixer/juicer: protection against access to live parts (8), leakage current and electric strength at operating temperature (13), provision for earthing (27) of IS 302 (Part 2/Sec 14), plus a simple running test to verify satisfactory functioning
